title: Web Summit revenues climb to nearly 48m in 2019 (The Irish Times, 2021)
what_it_says: The Irish Times reports the Web Summit group's 2019 revenue of 47.9 million euros from newly filed accounts, the 70,469 attendees of the last in-person event in November 2019, the relocation to Lisbon in 2016 under a deal with the Portuguese government, a 10-year hosting agreement, and the 104,000 who joined the online 2020 event.
status: publication date not shown on the page as fetched; the text places it in 2021
